analysis: SFMC-REQ-045 clearly states functional requirements for the software to record specific operational event categories in the mission log. The categories (operating mode changes, pilot commands, detected faults, weapons firing, emergency events, fleet communications) correspond to defined subsystem functions in the SRS. The requirement contains no vague degree words, escape clauses, or unassigned responsibilities. It is not a safety control or hazard mitigation function, so no SWE-184 link applies.
summary: SFMC-REQ-045 clearly defines the specific event categories that the software must record in the mission log. It contains no quality defects and is acceptable as written.
